\begin{lstlisting}[language={},basicstyle=\ttfamily\scriptsize,breaklines=true]
# Generated by LeanFM from protocol SignIn: the requests Idp serves. Regenerate it rather than editing.
components:
  schemas:
    Authorize:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "The browser follows the redirect: the same parameters, as a GET on the provider."
      properties:
        client_id:
          type: "string"
        code_challenge:
          type: "string"
        redirect_uri:
          type: "string"
        state:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "state"
        - "client_id"
        - "redirect_uri"
        - "code_challenge"
      title: "Authorize"
      type: "object"
    BadCode:
      additionalProperties: false
      properties: {}
      required: []
      title: "BadCode"
      type: "object"
    Credentials:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "The person signs in at the provider; the password is a secret, never logged."
      properties:
        password_secr:
          type: "string"
        state:
          type: "string"
        username:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "username"
        - "password_secr"
        - "state"
      title: "Credentials"
      type: "object"
    DeniedBack:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "Or the provider sends the browser back with an error, such as access_denied."
      properties:
        error:
          type: "string"
        state:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "state"
        - "error"
      title: "DeniedBack"
      type: "object"
    ExchangeCode:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "The app exchanges the code at the provider, proving it holds the PKCE verifier."
      properties:
        client_id:
          type: "string"
        code:
          type: "string"
        code_verifier_secr:
          type: "string"
        redirect_uri:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "code"
        - "redirect_uri"
        - "client_id"
        - "code_verifier_secr"
      title: "ExchangeCode"
      type: "object"
    LoginPage:
      additionalProperties: false
      properties: {}
      required: []
      title: "LoginPage"
      type: "object"
    RedirectBack:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "The provider sends the browser back to the app with a one-time code."
      properties:
        code:
          type: "string"
        state:
          type: "string"
      required:
        - "state"
        - "code"
      title: "RedirectBack"
      type: "object"
    Tokens:
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "The tokens are secrets, never logged."
      properties:
        access_token_secr:
          type: "string"
        expires_in:
          minimum: 0
          type: "integer"
      required:
        - "access_token_secr"
        - "expires_in"
      title: "Tokens"
      type: "object"
info:
  description: "The requests Idp receives in protocol SignIn, generated by LeanFM from the session type."
  title: "SignIn: Idp"
  version: "0.1.0"
openapi: "3.1.0"
paths:
  "/authorize":
    get:
      operationId: "Authorize"
      parameters:
        - in: "query"
          name: "state"
          required: true
          schema:
            type: "string"
        - in: "query"
          name: "client_id"
          required: true
          schema:
            type: "string"
        - in: "query"
          name: "redirect_uri"
          required: true
          schema:
            type: "string"
        - in: "query"
          name: "code_challenge"
          required: true
          schema:
            type: "string"
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            "application/json":
              schema:
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/LoginPage"
          description: "LoginPage"
      summary: "Authorize from Browser"
  "/login":
    post:
      operationId: "Credentials"
      requestBody:
        content:
          "application/json":
            schema:
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Credentials"
      responses:
        "302":
          description: "RedirectBack or DeniedBack: the Location URL carries state, code, error as query parameters"
          headers:
            Location:
              required: true
              schema:
                format: "uri"
                type: "string"
      summary: "Credentials from Browser"
  "/token":
    post:
      operationId: "ExchangeCode"
      requestBody:
        content:
          "application/json":
            schema:
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ExchangeCode"
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            "application/json":
              schema:
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Tokens"
          description: "Tokens"
        "400":
          content:
            "application/json":
              schema:
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/BadCode"
          description: "BadCode"
      summary: "ExchangeCode from App"
\end{lstlisting}
